name: Klaviyo
shortDescription: Email and SMS campaigns with flows, plus an AI subject-line generator.
longDescription: Klaviyo sends email and text campaigns with flows and an AI subject-line generator. Free email plan for up to 250 active profiles and 500 sends a month. See their site for paid pricing.
pricingNotes: Free email plan for up to 250 active profiles and 500 sends a month. See their site for paid pricing.
bestFor: Scheduling promo email and text campaigns
notIdealFor: Someone who needs one confirmed monthly price
strength: Klaviyo's help center describes a free email plan with up to 250 active profiles and 500 email sends a month.
weakness: Paid pricing is on their site, beyond the free email plan of 250 active profiles and 500 sends a month.

useCaseFit.marketing-promotions: Describes email and SMS campaigns, flows, and a free email plan for small lists.
